entities.summary: Pablo Laso Biurrun is a Spanish professional basketball coach and former player. He is currently the head coach for Anadolu Efes of the BSL and EuroLeague. He was the head coach of Real Madrid for eleven seasons from 2011 to 2022, guiding them to two EuroLeague championships and six ACB titles. As a player, he was a prominent point guard in Spain and Italy.
